update.name: Content - FG AutoLightbox (Joomla 3.10 classic)
update.description: Automatically adds a lightbox to all images in Joomla articles. No external dependencies. Classic build for Joomla 3.10 only - frozen, no longer under active development. For Joomla 6, see the native build in the joomla6/ folder of this repository.
